headline_pain: Rent Up 20%? There's a Way Out
headline_outcome: Own a Warehouse for Less Than Rent
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." What if your monthly repayment was less than your current rent — and you owned the asset at the end? That's the reality for small businesses buying off-the-plan in Truganina. Brand-new warehouses, built to your spec, right off Princes Freeway in Melbourne's fastest-growing industrial corridor. Lock in the price now, settle when construction completes. No more annual rent hikes. No more dead money. Just a real asset on your balance sheet.
description: Monthly repayments often less than rent — own a new Truganina warehouse outright.
